summary: Uninstall feels laggy because install-state is derived from a disk stat - a Pod wrapper round trip on remote. Fixing it needs an optimistic install-state flip, which relaxes the install-state-IS-files-on-disk invariant. Product decision, parked as an idea.
Widened to both directions - an install's card move lags the same way (toast ~7s, move ~10s). Same disk-stat root.

NUMBERS MARKED STALE - probably fixed by MPI-398, needs a re-measure to say so. Every timing on this card (toast ~7s, move ~10s) was taken on wrapper 0.2.38, hours before MPI-398 shipped. Traced the chain to be sure: /comfy/models/check -> remoteModelsCheck -> POST /wrapper/models/status at routes/remoteModels.js:374, which is exactly the handler MPI-398 moved off the wrapper single asyncio loop - it had been looping _is_complete_on_disk over 100+ deps synchronously, about 10s, freezing neighbouring requests as well. Cold-open p50 for that endpoint went 8679ms -> 2259ms on 0.2.40, so the expectation is a ~2s move rather than ~10s: mostly fixed, not provably fixed, and models/status is deliberately uncached so it will never be free. Card stays todo/idea. Acceptance regrown to put the re-measure FIRST, and the check is queued as item 7 on the MPI-385 Pod-sweep brief because it rides free on the uninstall item 6 already plans. Do not touch the install-state-IS-files-on-disk invariant until that number exists.

Re-measured on wrapper dev 0.2.40 (MPI-385 item 7, klein-4b 12.7GB): INSTALL direction fixed outright - toast and section move land the same frame. UNINSTALL direction ~3s residual (was ~10s), no uninstall toast fired at all (old symptom said toast ~7s). In line with MPI-398 cold-open p50 2259ms for the models/status round trip. Card stays parked: closing the 3s needs the optimistic install-state flip - the user's product call. Numbers on validation.md.
